**Principles of Surveying:**
1. **Work from whole to part:** Establishing major control points with high precision first, then filling in detailed measurements locally to prevent the accumulation of errors.
2. **Location of a point by measurement from two control points:** The position of any new point must be fixed by at least two independent measurements (such as linear and angular).

**Conversion of WCB to Quadrant Bearings (QCB):**

(i) $165^\circ 36' 48''$ (Quadrant II, S-E):
$$\text{QCB} = 180^\circ - 165^\circ 36' 48'' = \mathbf{S\, 14^\circ 23' 12''\, E}$$

(ii) $59^\circ$ (Quadrant I, N-E):
$$\text{QCB} = \mathbf{N\, 59^\circ\, E}$$

(iii) $327^\circ 14'$ (Quadrant IV, N-W):
$$\text{QCB} = 360^\circ - 327^\circ 14' = \mathbf{N\, 32^\circ 46'\, W}$$

(iv) $270^\circ$ (lies on West axis):
$$\text{QCB} = \mathbf{Due\, West}$$
proTip: Always mention the quadrant letters (N-E, S-E, etc.) while writing Quadrant Bearings (Reduced Bearings).
